output.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear with features such as dead-front construction, heavy-duty utility service, and accessibility for metering and control equipment. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product that provides arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, meeting the specified technical requirements for the Syracuse Airport Specification for Metal Clad Switchgear.
